                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                You'll work with data scientists in iwoca's other customer flow teams, and join the analytics guild \u2013 iwoca's data science community \u2013 to align on methods and build your expertise.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 Live project examples:<\/p>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Pre-qualification. <\/strong>Measuring how showing customers what they could borrow before they apply affects conversion and Customer Lifetime Value (CLtV), then shaping how the model behind it develops.<\/p><\/li>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Credit cards. <\/strong>Working out which customers should see iwoca's recently launched credit card, a Flexi-Loan, or both \u2013 and whether the card wins extra customers or takes them from Flexi-Loan.<\/p><\/li>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Top-up notifications. <\/strong>Measuring whether letting eligible customers know they can borrow more increases CLtV, using causal inference methods beyond a standard A\/B test.<\/p><\/li>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Partner funnel. <\/strong>Building a clear view from application to drawdown, finding where customers drop off, and testing fixes where they'll matter most.<\/p><\/li><\/ul>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to Enterprise Account Executive - Strategic Outcomes

Our Company

VergeSense is the world's leading Workplace AI platform. We help Fortune 500 enterprises transform static real estate portfolios into highly optimized, dynamic environments. Powered by our proprietary Large Spatial Model (LSM), our Meridian Platform unifies Wi-Fi, badge, booking systems, and spatial sensor networks to shift corporate real estate (CRE) from reactive reporting to AI-driven predictive planning. Our clients use VergeSense to drive quantifiable outcomes, such as multi-million dollar lease avoidances and optimized facilities footprints.

The Opportunity

We are seeking an outcomes-focused, deeply consultative Enterprise Account Executive to drive net-new business within our highest-value accounts. In this role, you will not sell software features; you will sell business transformations, financial optimization, and employee experience strategies. You will partner with C-level executives (Chief Real Estate Officers, CFOs, and CIOs) to uncover hidden millions in underutilized real estate assets and structure complex enterprise agreements mapped directly to client-side ROI.

You'll open conversations by asking about the space decisions a customer faces in the next 12 months, then work out how they make those decisions today and how confident they are in them. Only then do you bring the right mix of platform, data, and services to fit their situation. You'll sell to real estate, workplace, facilities, and planning leaders, and you'll often be competing against the status quo: a broker, a consultant, or an internal team doing the math by hand.

About You

  • Execute Consultative Value-Selling: Lead deep-discovery engagements to understand an enterprise's portfolio constraints, hybrid workforce patterns, and strategic capital expenditure goals.

  • Architect Multi-Stakeholder Solutions: Build coalitions across historically siloed departments like Corporate Real Estate (CRE), Workplace Strategy, HR, Procurement, and Enterprise, aligning them behind a shared vision of spatial intelligence.

  • Deliver Outcome-Based Proposals: Partner with our outcome focused internal teams to deliver financial impact assessments and business cases. You will translate complex spatial metrics (e.g., active vs. passive occupancy) into board-ready data-backed decisions.

  • Manage Complex, Multi-Stage Cycles: Own the end-to-end enterprise sales cycle from initial strategic mapping through technical validation and sophisticated contract negotiations.

  • Leverage Strategic Integrations: Monetize and navigate strategic ecosystem alignments, positioning our native integrations with major players to accelerate time-to-value for joint enterprise clients.

  • Maintain Pipeline Rigor: Consistently hit quarterly and annual revenue targets through disciplined pipeline management, accurate forecasting, and a strong land-and-expand strategy.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience:5+ years of quota-carrying enterprise SaaS sales experience managing 6-figure and 7-figure transaction values (100k–1M+ ARR).

  • Sales Methodology: Demonstrated expertise in consultative, value-driven enterprise methodologies.

  • Executive Presence: Proven track record of building trusted relationships with senior cross-functional executives and presenting to executive steering committees.

  • Analytical Acumen: Comfortable interpreting technical platform data, AI scenario models, or network architecture capabilities and translating them into high-level business logic.

  • Track Record: Verifiable history of continuous quota overachievement (Top 10% of the team).

Preferred

  • Background selling into Corporate Real Estate (CRE), PropTech, Integrated Workplace Management Systems (IWMS), Smart Building architecture, or high-value Enterprise Infrastructure SaaS.

  • Consulting Experience with a proven ability to uncover the true need of the prospect and pivot the conversation and solution to meeting those needs.

  • Competitive compensation and equity

Company Overview

Established in 2008, Zicasso is the most-reviewed and highest-rated luxury travel company, specializing in immersive custom tours, vacations, and safaris. Our Zicasso travel specialists are the world’s top 2% of boutique tour operators and travel agents, pre-vetted and handpicked to compete in creating itineraries tailored to each of our travelers’ unique preferences. Joining Zicasso, you'll play a key role in bringing our travelers’ dreams to life—pushing the boundaries of what’s possible with luxury travel experiences.

As a member of our team, you’ll be part of a company recognized for its strong brand reputation among discerning travelers. Our authority in the luxury travel industry is consistently affirmed through features in top media outlets, including The New York Times, The Wall Street Journal, BBC, Forbes, CNN, and Condé Nast Traveler, to name a few. See our press coverage here.

We are a fully remote company spanning five continents, and we foster a dynamic, progressive global work environment that values creativity, initiative, and continuous learning. We're seeking passionate, data-driven individuals who thrive in a high-performance environment and are eager to contribute to our innovative company culture, underpinned by a consistent pursuit of excellence, integrity, and teamwork.

Our global team comes together biannually for international retreats and summits. These are typically held for a week at a new location each time, providing opportunities to share ideas, collaborate in person, and strengthen our culture, all while learning firsthand about the destinations we serve. These events embody our commitment to both professional growth and the transformative power of travel.

Join us in shaping the future of luxury travel while working towards our vision—creating a more connected humanity through travel. To learn more, visit.

The Role

We are seeking a highly experienced and passionate Product Designer to join our dynamic team and lead the design efforts for our innovative applications. As a Product Designer, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the user experience and driving product strategy. This role will report into the Senior Product Manager and work closely with the engineering team, and stakeholders to deliver exceptional user-centered solutions.

This is an international, fully-remote, freelance contractor position, working from home, at a location outside of the United States. We are particularly seeking candidates who are based in Latin America.

There is flexibility in your work hours but we expect that you will generally maximize your overlap with California hours (eg. until 3pm Pacific Time Zone).

The work will all be conducted in English.

Key Responsibilities

  • Participate in product strategy discussions, contributing to the overall vision and roadmap
  • Collaborate with the Product and Engineering managers in leading a Product Squad, collaborating closely with stakeholders to define and implement innovative solutions for our new B2C and B2B web applications and internal platform.
  • Contribute to the implementation of Product Design best practices when necessary to set a new standard and increase Zicasso’s product culture maturity.
  • Conduct user research to gather insights, identify user needs, and inform design decisions.
  • Create user flows, wireframes, mockups, and prototypes to effectively communicate design ideas and concepts.
  • Create detailed handoff documentation that includes design files, component specifications (typography, spacing, colors), and interaction behaviors.
  • Iterate and refine designs based on feedback, user testing, and data-driven decision-making.
  • Ensure a consistent and cohesive visual language, driven by our core Brand ID and customer-first orientation, across all applications, adhering to established design systems and guidelines.
  • Advocate for a user-centered design approach and promote design best practices within the team.

Required Experience

  • 4+ years of experience in product design, with a proven track record of leading design initiatives.
  • Extensive experience in the travel industry, and/or luxury products and services, is highly preferred.
  • Experience in web design and diverse user research techniques will be appreciated.
  • A strong passion for travel and creating exceptional user experiences.
  • Proven proficiency in design tools such as Figma, Sketch, or similar.
  • Demonstrated expertise in UI design, information architecture, interaction design, and visual design.
  • Exceptional communication, presentation, and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence and persuade stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to work effectively in a remote environment.
  • Deep understanding of agile development methodologies.
  • Strong understanding and experience with product strategy, metrics and OKRs.
  • Experience leading design reviews and mentoring other designers.
  • Experience in fast paced growing environments, either in start ups or nimble structures.
  • Experience defining and implementing design best practices.

What We Offer

  • Remote work from your home base and flexible hours that allow you to enjoy a great work-life balance.
  • Innovative, fast-paced and collaborative culture that values diverse voices and opinions.
  • Learning and development annual budget.
  • Two company-sponsored business trips each year at international destinations we serve!

Addepto is a leading AI consulting () and data engineering () company that builds scalable, ROI-focused AI solutions for some of the world's largest enterprises and pioneering startups, including Rolls Royce, Continental, Porsche, ABB, and WGU. With an exclusive focus on Artificial Intelligence and Big Data, Addepto helps organizations unlock the full potential of their data through systems designed for measurable business impact and long-term growth.

The company's work extends beyond client engagements. Drawing from real-world challenges and insights, Addepto has developed its own product - ContextClue - and actively contributes open-source solutions to the AI community. This commitment to transforming practical experience into scalable innovation has earned Addepto recognition by Forbes as one of the top 10 AI consulting companies worldwide.

As part of KMS Technology, a US-based global technology group, Addepto combines deep AI specialization with enterprise-scale delivery capabilities—enabling the partnership to move clients from AI experimentation to production impact, securely and at scale.

We are modernizing a large, business-critical operational platform that has evolved over many years and combines application logic, database-level rules, and partly manual operational processes. The project involves transitioning the existing solution towards a modern, cloud-native architecture, delivered by a small senior team working with heavy AI leverage.

As a Senior Java Developer, you will join the team at the moment when requirements and target architecture are in place and the build starts. This is a hands-on implementation role — the large majority of your time goes into writing, testing, and shipping production code, not into high-level design or governance.

Here is what the project involves:

  • Re-implementing legacy logic. Working through existing Java/Spring code, Oracle schemas, and PL/SQL, extracting the business rules that actually run the operation, and rebuilding them as clean, well-tested Spring Boot services.

  • Building the new platform on Azure. Implementing services, integrations, and APIs on Azure with PostgreSQL as the operational database and Databricks for analytics and reporting data.

  • Migrating without stopping operations. Moving data and functionality from Oracle to the new stack in a way that supports parallel run, reconciliation, and a safe cutover for a system that cannot go down.

🚀 Your main responsibilities:

  • Design and implement backend services in Java and Spring Boot, from domain model and business logic through persistence and API layers.

  • Analyze legacy Java/Spring code and Oracle PL/SQL, and re-implement business logic in the new services, with tests that prove behavioural parity.

  • Build the PostgreSQL data layer: schema design, JPA/Hibernate mappings, versioned migrations (Flyway / Liquibase), and query performance tuning.

  • Implement Oracle → PostgreSQL data migration and reconciliation tooling to support parallel run and cutover.

With a focus on talent acquisition and continuous improvement, you will ensure exceptional service delivery, customer satisfaction, and the identification of opportunities for improvement. The ideal candidate is excited about designing processes that support the quickest claim resolution with optimal outcomes. About UserWise

We’re building a high-speed, AI-assisted game production team focused on developing and scaling mobile games globally.

This is not a traditional game team. We operate with ownership, clarity, and execution speed, leveraging AI-driven workflows to move faster than most studios.

We work across a global team, building production-ready games and scaling them through LiveOps. Our focus is simple: increase the number of high-quality bets and turn them into scalable products.

Our team has already worked across established franchises such as Fruit Ninja and Wordscapes, contributing to both development and growth initiatives.

The Role

We’re looking for a senior game designer with strong product management understanding to help us identify, build, validate, and scale new game products.

This is a product builder role. You’ll work closely with our Chief AI Officer, combining strong game design, product thinking, data, and AI-assisted workflows to turn opportunities into playable products quickly.

You’ll own the what and why behind the product, while staying close enough to the work to turn ideas into prototypes, tests, and production-ready games.

What You’ll Do

  • Identify and evaluate new game opportunities through market analysis, competitor deconstruction, player insights, and product data
  • Turn opportunities into clear product bets, defining the concept, target audience, core loop, product hypothesis, success metrics, and commercial opportunity
  • Own AI-assisted game design across core loops, systems, progression, economy, UX, retention, and monetization
  • Rapidly prototype and validate game concepts using AI-assisted tools and lightweight development workflows
  • Define success metrics, analyze player behavior and test results, and make clear recommendations on whether to scale, iterate, or kill
  • Own product priorities and make trade-offs based on player impact, data, development effort, and business potential
  • Continuously improve games based on retention, engagement, monetization, experimentation, and player behavior
  • Partner closely with leadership to evolve how AI is used to design, prototype, build, and scale games faster

Requirements

  • 6+ years of experience in mobile games, ideally across casual or hybrid-casual products
  • Strong game design experience combined with product management or meaningful product ownership
  • Experience taking games or significant products from concept through launch and post-launch iteration
  • A track record of owning product outcomes and KPIs, not just individual features
  • Strong understanding of gameplay systems, progression, economy, UX, retention, monetization, and LiveOps
  • Strong understanding of F2P game economics and metrics, including retention, engagement, monetization, LTV, CPI, and related product performance indicators
  • Comfort working with analytics and experimentation, including interpreting data, forming hypotheses, designing tests, and acting on results
  • Ability to deconstruct successful games, understand why they work, and turn those learnings into product decisions
  • Experience using AI-assisted tools for ideation, prototyping, analysis, design, or content creation
  • Ability to turn ambiguous opportunities into clear product direction and executable priorities
  • High ownership and independent decision-making. You move quickly and don’t wait for perfect information
  • Strong execution mindset. You build, ship, learn, and improve rather than getting stuck in process

Environment

  • High ownership: You own product decisions and outcomes
  • High speed: We build, test, ship, and iterate quickly
  • AI-assisted workflows: AI is embedded into how we design and build
  • Data-driven: Product decisions are informed by player behavior and measurable outcomes
  • Global team: Work across multiple regions and disciplines
  • Low bureaucracy: Minimal process, maximum execution

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Competitive USD compensation
  • Paid Time Off
  • Performance Bonus
  • Annual Performance Reviews

About the Role
We are looking for a Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to improve the reliability of our AI and analytics platforms and the services that depend on them. As Intermedia expands its global product deployments, this role will strengthen SRE practices across production infrastructure, data pipelines, machine-learning services, customer-facing analytics, and AI-powered Voice and Unified Communications capabilities. You will partner with AI, data, product, and platform teams to build scalable, observable systems that deliver dependable insights and resilient customer experiences.

What you will be doing:

  • Run and improve production environments that support AI and AI workloads, data pipelines, analytics applications, and customer-facing services.
  • Build software and automation to manage cloud infrastructure, data platforms, model-serving infrastructure, and application services.
  • Define and measure service level indicators, service level objectives, and error budgets for AI and analytics services, including availability, data freshness, pipeline completion, and inference latency.
  • Build end-to-end observability that correlates metrics, logs, and traces with data-quality signals, AI-service performance, and customer impact.
  • Monitor and optimize the reliability, performance, capacity, and cost of batch and streaming workloads, analytics queries, and inference services.
  • Partner with data engineering and machine-learning teams to make ingestion, transformation, feature, training, deployment, and reporting workflows production-ready.
  • Automate CI/CD and production-readiness checks for data pipelines, model and prompt releases, schema changes, analytics applications, and dashboards.
  • Detect and resolve data-quality incidents involving missing, stale, delayed, or anomalous data, schema drift, and broken lineage or dependencies.
  • Design and test graceful degradation, dependency isolation, retry and fallback patterns, and recovery procedures for impaired AI, data, or downstream services.
  • Improve the reliability of AI-powered Voice and Unified Communications capabilities such as speech recognition, transcription, summarization, intelligent routing, conversational assistance, and text-to-speech.
  • Establish operational monitoring for model and AI-service behavior, including latency, throughput, error rates, drift indicators, and changes in output quality.
  • Plan capacity and run performance, load, and resilience tests across compute-intensive AI workloads, distributed data processing, and analytics services.
  • Lead incident response and post-incident improvement for AI and analytics services, using measurable actions to reduce recurrence and recovery time.
  • Support secure and reliable access to cloud storage, processing, and query services used by analytics products and internal decision-making.
  • Reduce operational toil and improve engineering productivity through platform tooling, runbooks, self-service automation, and clear operational standards.

What you will bring to the role:

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, data engineering, software engineering, or another technical or scientific discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 4-7 years of experience in production operations, systems engineering, SRE or DevOps, software deployment, and maintenance of distributed production systems.
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure, containers, Kubernetes, distributed systems, and scalable compute and storage services.
  • Experience operating data processing, orchestration, storage, or analytics technologies, such as Kafka, Spark, Airflow, dbt, data warehouses, or comparable cloud services.
  • Ability to use metrics, logs, traces, data-quality checks, freshness indicators, lineage, and service-level indicators to diagnose complex production issues.
  • Experience with CI/CD, DataOps or MLOps practices, automated testing, controlled rollout, and rollback of data and AI service changes.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across Linux, applications, networks, APIs, data pipelines, and distributed service dependencies, with attention to security and access controls.
  • Strong analytical problem-solving and cross-functional communication skills, with a proactive approach to reliability, performance, and continuous improvement.

Diversity Inclusion and Equal Opportunity

Type d'affectation : Volontariat Virtuel

Emplacement du partenaire : Benin

Date de début : Novembre 2026

Durée de l’affectation : 3 mois (7 heures par semaine au minimum)

Exigences linguistiques : Français et Anglais Niveau 4 - Avancée

Éligibilité : Ouvert aux citoyens canadiens et aux résidents permanents du Canada uniquement

Rôle du coopérant-volontaire

Notre partenaire L'ANPE souhaite renforcer la visibilité et l'attractivité de sa plateforme dédiée au volontariat afin de promouvoir davantage les opportunités d'engagement citoyen et de valoriser l'impact des volontaires sur le développement socioéconomique du pays.

À travers cette mission virtuelle, le ou la coopérant(e)-volontaire apportera son expertise en communication numérique, en marketing de contenu et en storytelling afin de rendre la plateforme plus dynamique, engageante et accessible. La personne retenue contribuera également à transformer les réalisations et expériences des volontaires en récits inspirants capables de mobiliser de nouveaux partenaires, volontaires et parties prenantes.

Le/la coopérant(e)-volontaire devra mener les activités suivantes :

  • Contribuer à l'animation et à l'amélioration de la plateforme dédiée au volontariat
  • Proposer de nouvelles rubriques et approches de contenu afin d'en accroître l'attractivité et la visibilité
  • Appuyer la création et la diffusion de contenus numériques adaptés aux différents publics cibles
  • Recueillir, analyser et valoriser les expériences et réalisations des volontaires
  • Rédiger des témoignages, portraits, articles et récits d'impact mettant en lumière les contributions des volontaires

Compétences académiques essentielles :

  • Diplôme universitaire en communication, journalisme, marketing, design graphique, médias numériques ou dans tout autre domaine pertinent

Compétences professionnelles essentielles :

  • Minimum de deux (2) années d'expérience en communication ou dans un domaine connexe
  • Expérience en communication web, rédaction de contenu ou gestion de plateformes numériques
  • Bonne connaissance des techniques de storytelling et de création de contenu engageant

À propos du coopérant-volontaire

Le programme de volontariat virtuel de Cuso International accueille de nouveaux et anciens bénévoles à travailler à distance avec nos partenaires internationaux et bureaux pays. Le volontariat virtuel offre plusieurs des avantages du volontariat international, cependant se démarque pour sa flexibilité; pouvant être géré à partir de chez soi et en accord avec sa disponibilité. Contribuer ses compétences à une communauté, acquérir de nouvelles compétences, et de faire de nouvelles connexions sont les avantages communs du volontariat virtuel, et pour Cuso International c’est aussi une grande opportunité pour engager plus de personnes dans sa mission.

Certains de nos partenaires se trouvent dans des zones reculées avec une connexion Internet peu fiable. Par conséquent, lorsque vous travaillez avec les partenaires, il est raisonnable de supposer que les réponses à vos courriels ne seront pas envoyées immédiatement (structure change in this sentence). De plus, pour certains de nos partenaires, il s'agit de leur première expérience de travail avec des volontaires virtuel, de sorte que la flexibilité et la patience sont une caractéristique précieuse du volontariat virtuel.

A propos de nous

Cuso International (Cuso) est une organisation internationale de coopération et de développement basée au Canada qui œuvre à créer des opportunités sociales et économiques pour les groupes méritant l'équité. Forts de plus de soixante ans d'expérience, nous relevons les défis mondiaux en nous attaquant aux causes profondes des inégalités. En collaboration avec nos partenaires, nous nous concentrons sur les efforts visant à améliorer la résilience économique, à promouvoir l'équité et l'inclusion pour tous et à faire progresser l'action climatique. Nous croyons qu'en partageant nos compétences et habiletés, nous pouvons bâtir un avenir meilleur. Guidée par ses valeurs de courage, d'inclusion, de durabilité et de redevabilité, Cuso combine des stratégies innovantes et des partenariats durables pour créer un changement significatif et durable dans les communautés d'Afrique, d'Amérique latine, des Caraïbes et du Canada.

Projet : Partage du savoir-faire canadien pour un développement inclusif et l’égalité entre les sexes (SHARE)

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Portugal - Remote
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>Be Part of Building the Future</strong></h2>
<p>Dremio is the unified lakehouse platform for self-service analytics and AI, serving hundreds of global enterprises, including Maersk, Amazon, Regeneron, NetApp, and S&amp;P Global. Customers rely on Dremio for cloud, hybrid, and on-prem lakehouses to power their data mesh, data warehouse migration, data virtualization, and unified data access use cases. Based on open source technologies, including Apache Iceberg and Apache Arrow, Dremio provides an open lakehouse architecture enabling the fastest time to insight and platform flexibility at a fraction of the cost.&nbsp; Learn more at&nbsp;<a class="c-link" href="http://www.dremio.com/">www.dremio.com.</a></p></div><p><strong>About the role</strong></p>
<p>In this role you will get opportunities to implement and maintain CI/CD systems and developer productivity solutions. You will be responsible for both regularly scheduled work as well as on-demand break-fix work to support Dremio’s CI/CD system, identifying areas of improvement, and implementing changes to increase efficiency and effectiveness of those systems.</p>
<p>Bring your industry experience to improve the efficiency and scale of Dremio’s infrastructure via innovation on tooling and methodologies. You should have empathy for developers and a passion for engineering productivity.&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>What you’ll be doing</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Solve problems for fellow Dremio engineers by:</li>
<ul>
<li>Leveraging and contributing to playbooks to implement solutions to unblock them</li>
<li>Identifying short term workarounds and documenting them</li>
<li>Automating processes where manual processes exist.</li>
</ul>
<li>Working on infrastructure across all major clouds (AWS, GCP, Azure).</li>
<li>Managing access to key infrastructure.</li>
<li>Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and associated systems to increase organizational efficiency.</li>
<li>Automate local development workflows.</li>
<li>Analyze performance bottlenecks, root cause issues, file defects, follow up with developers, and document resolutions.</li>
<li>Clear focus on keeping our development branches ‘green’.&nbsp;</li>
<li>Release engineering - automating processes to push software to delivery endpoints.</li>
<li>Report out on the status, reliability and robustness of our CI/CD systems.</li>
<li>Actively participate in code reviews.&nbsp;</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>What we’re looking for</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>B.S. or M.S in Computer Science or in a related technical field</li>
<li>1+ years of experience on large scale distributed systems</li>
<li>Comfortable navigating the fast moving, unstructured nature of a hyper-growth startup.</li>
<li>Demonstrable Knowledge and Experience with at least one cloud platform (AWS, Azure, GCP)</li>
<li>Basic understanding of cloud networking and cloud architecture.</li>
<li>Proficiency in any of Java/C++/Python/Go</li>
<li>Knowledge of Maven or similar build environments</li>
<li>Hands on experience in pipeline automation using CI/CD tools like Jenkins&nbsp;</li>
<li>Experience in Infrastructure as Code</li>
<li>Experience with Terraform, BASH, Docker, Jenkins, and Kubernetes</li>
<li>Ability to write technical reports, effectively summarizing key data</li>
<li>Passion for learning and then delivering solutions using latest technologies</li>
<li>Strong Affinity for collaboration and teamwork</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;<strong>Bonus points if you have</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Working knowledge in data lakes and data warehousing</li>
<li>Proficient with SQL</li>
</ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong>What we value&nbsp;</strong></h3>
<p><span>At Dremio, we hold ourselves to high standards when it comes to People, Thinking, and Action. Our Gnarlies (that's what we call our employees) communicate with clarity, drive accountability, and are respectful towards each other. We confront brutal facts and focus on results while operating with a sense of urgency and building a "flywheel". People who like to jump in and drive momentum will thrive in our #GnarlyLife.</span></p>
<p><em><span>Dremio is an equal opportunity employer supporting workforce diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other unlawful factor.</span></em></p>
<p><em><span>Dremio is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.</span></em></p>
<p><em><span>Dremio has policies in place to protect the personal information that employees and applicants disclose to us. Please click </span></em><a href="https://docs.google.com/document/d/1CB96QFmOX-bFy48YFOe2GO5lmdawOpKKBj8DpTgsuNg/edit?usp=sharing"><em><span>here</span></em></a><em><span> to review the privacy notice.&nbsp;</span></em></p>

      <title>Dremio: Senior Staff Software Engineer - Query Execution</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Portugal - Remote
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>Be Part of Building the Future</strong></h2>
<p>Dremio is the unified lakehouse platform for self-service analytics and AI, serving hundreds of global enterprises, including Maersk, Amazon, Regeneron, NetApp, and S&amp;P Global. Customers rely on Dremio for cloud, hybrid, and on-prem lakehouses to power their data mesh, data warehouse migration, data virtualization, and unified data access use cases. Based on open source technologies, including Apache Iceberg and Apache Arrow, Dremio provides an open lakehouse architecture enabling the fastest time to insight and platform flexibility at a fraction of the cost.&nbsp; Learn more at&nbsp;<a class="c-link" href="http://www.dremio.com/">www.dremio.com.</a></p></div><p><strong>About the role</strong></p>
<p>Dremio’s Query Execution team builds the runtime responsible for executing analytical queries at scale. The team sits between query planning and table scans, owning the systems that turn query plans into efficient, reliable execution.</p>
<p>As a Senior Staff Software Engineer, you’ll work on query operators, expression evaluation, memory management, execution scheduling, runtime planning, and performance optimization. Your work will directly affect query performance, scalability, and reliability across Dremio’s cloud data platform.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>What you’ll be doing</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Build the execution engine: Design, implement, test, and support query operators, expression evaluation, execution scheduling, runtime planning, and resource management.</li>
<li>Improve runtime performance: Optimize vectorized processing, concurrency, parallelism, memory usage, data exchange, and disk spilling.</li>
<li>Diagnose difficult problems: Investigate query correctness and performance issues using query profiles, profiling tools, telemetry, benchmarks, logs, and production data.</li>
<li>Optimize Java and the JVM: Improve CPU utilization, allocation behavior, garbage collection, thread behavior, and other runtime characteristics.</li>
<li>Collaborate across the query engine: Work with Query Planner, Datalake, Product, Support, and field engineering teams on end-to-end query improvements.</li>
<li>Use AI-assisted development tools: Apply AI tools to code comprehension, debugging, test generation, documentation, and incident analysis.</li>
<li>Apply engineering judgment: Validate AI-generated code and recommendations through review, testing, benchmarking, and engineering judgment.</li>
<li>Raise the engineering bar: Participate in design and code reviews, contribute to technical direction, and mentor other engineers.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>What we’re looking for</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Software engineering experience: 5+ years developing production software, preferably in database systems, query execution, distributed systems, or related areas.</li>
<li>Programming skills: Strong Java skills; experience with C++ is a plus.</li>
<li>Computer science fundamentals: Strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, concurrency, multithreaded programming, and asynchronous programming.</li>
<li>Database and distributed systems knowledge: Understanding of database internals, query processing, distributed execution, and performance optimization.</li>
<li>Performance engineering experience: Experience profiling and optimizing CPU, memory, garbage collection, thread behavior, or other runtime characteristics.</li>
<li>Problem-solving ability: Ability to solve ambiguous technical problems and work effectively across team boundaries.</li>
<li>Engineering judgment: Ability to evaluate tradeoffs, validate solutions rigorously, and make sound decisions when working with unfamiliar or AI-assisted implementations.</li>
<li>Communication and ownership: Strong communication skills, a sense of ownership, and a commitment to delivering high-quality software.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Bonus points if you have</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Query engines: Distributed query engines, database engines, or large-scale data processing systems.</li>
<li>Execution techniques: Vectorized execution, query operators, expression evaluation, code generation, or runtime optimization.</li>
<li>Runtime systems: JVM profiling, memory management, caching, networking, data exchange, execution scheduling, or disk spilling.</li>
<li>Data platforms: Apache Arrow, Apache Iceberg, Parquet, Avro, Spark, Hadoop, or cloud object stores.</li>
<li>Open source: Contributing to open-source projects.</li>
</ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong>What we value&nbsp;</strong></h3>

We confront brutal facts and focus on results while operating with a sense of urgency and building a "flywheel". People who like to jump in and drive momentum will thrive in our #GnarlyLife.</span></p>

      <title>Toggl: Senior Full Stack</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0074/7274/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Tallinn, Estonia
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://toggl.com/jobs/">https://toggl.com/jobs/</a>
</p>

<div class="_descriptionText_5yu8i_201 ashby-job-posting-description">
<p>We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to join one of our Product Tribes, the cross-functional units that own the end-to-end experience for a specific Toggl user role. You'll join the Tribe building for managers, the people who plan work, protect margins, and keep projects on time and on budget.</p>
<p>You own significant parts of that experience end-to-end, working hands-on with product and design to ship work that matters. You'll do this as we build and launch Toggl 2.0, our consolidated planning, time tracking, and time intelligence product.</p>
<p>The salary for this position is&nbsp;<strong>€83,000 annually.</strong></p>
<p>You can work from anywhere in the world&nbsp;<strong>as long as your main location is between UTC-4 and UTC+4.</strong></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2><strong>The Role</strong></h2>
<p>As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you own meaningful parts of the product end-to-end, from the data model and the API to the interface someone actually clicks: the technical approach, the quality of what ships, and whether it actually works for the people using it. You are accountable not for tickets closed, but for clarity, craft, and outcomes.</p>
<p>You'll work in the Tribe serving managers, across planning and capacity management, dashboards, and billable work. This is some of the most data-dense, interaction-heavy surface area in the product: schedules and capacity views, reports, and visualizations that have to stay fast and readable at real customer scale. The interesting problems live on both sides of the API here - the query behind a capacity view matters as much as how that view renders. You'll build with React and TypeScript on the frontend and our backend services (mostly Golang) and data layer (Postgres) behind them, alongside a product manager, a designer, and engineers who are used to owning their work and pushing back when something isn't right. In a tribe of 5 other engineers, your impact and visibility are high.</p>
<p>Our team meetings are scheduled between 11:00 and 16:00 UTC. Your availability and commitment to participate in these sessions are essential for effective collaboration and team alignment.</p>
<p>Your main responsibilities will be:</p>
<p><strong>Ownership and delivery</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Take projects from problem to production. Own the technical approach for major features front to back, break the work down sensibly, sequence it, and ship in slices rather than one big drop.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Make the technical calls in your area. Choose between options, name the tradeoffs, and decide without waiting for permission or escalating routine judgment.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Keep your work visible without being chased. Flag risks and slips early, keep the Tribe in the loop, and unblock yourself.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Craft and quality across the stack</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Build interfaces people trust with dense, real-world data. Planning views, dashboards, and reports that stay fast, accessible, and readable when the dataset gets ugly.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Design the data and API layer those views depend on. Model it so the feature you're building now doesn't make the next three harder.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Own performance as a feature, end to end. Profile, measure, and fix the slow query and the slow render instead of hoping the data stays small.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Write code others can work in. Sensible components and services, real test coverage where it earns its keep, and a codebase that's easier to change after you touch it.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Working with product and design</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Shape solutions, don't just implement them. Push on the problem, question requirements that don't hold up, and propose simpler paths when you see one.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Partner closely with design. Prototype early, spot the edge cases in a flow before it's built, and hold the bar on UX quality with your designer rather than after handoff.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Stay close to users and evidence. Join user tests, read the feedback, look at the data, and let it change what you build.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Raising the bar</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Review code with intent. Give precise, actionable feedback that makes the change and the person better.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Mentor and interview. Help other engineers grow, and help us hire well.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Improve things across team boundaries. Spot shared components and duplicated work between Tribes, and raise it before we build the same thing twice.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>AI as core leverage</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Use AI tools extensively in your daily work for exploration, prototyping, code generation and review, debugging, research, and writing. AI fluency is not optional. It's part of how you increase your speed, depth, and impact - and you're expected to help the rest of the Tribe get better at it too.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2><strong>About You</strong></h2>
<p>You will thrive in this role if you:</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Have significant experience building and shipping production web applications end to end, and can lead major projects rather than just contribute to them.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Are genuinely comfortable on both sides of the stack. You're deep on one side and properly capable on the other, not someone who hands off at the API boundary.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Have deep, practical knowledge of&nbsp;<strong>JavaScript, TypeScript, React, and modern CSS</strong>&nbsp;- including state management and side-effect handling in large applications.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Are solid on backend fundamentals: at least one backend language you know well, API design, relational data modelling, and enough instinct for query performance to spot the problem before production does.&nbsp;<strong>Prior Golang experience is not mandatory but you have to be willing to adopt it and become comfortable with it fast.</strong></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Hold an extremely high bar for quality. You know what great looks like, you notice the details others miss, and you don't ship work you wouldn't put your name on.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Have a knack for data-heavy product surfaces - performance, readability, and the principles behind a chart that actually communicates something.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Care about the user's problem, not just the ticket. You start from what someone is trying to get done and work back to the implementation.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Own outcomes, not output. You follow your work into production, watch how it behaves, and fix what needs fixing.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Thrive in ambiguity and move fast. You make confident decisions with incomplete information, adapt when things change, and course-correct without drama.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Are hands-on with AI tools. You actively use AI as a core part of how you build, not a side experiment, and you have opinions about where it helps and where it doesn't.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Don't need to be managed. You set your own direction, keep people in the loop, and ask for help when it matters.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Have excellent written and verbal English communication skills. You write clearly, explain technical tradeoffs to non-engineers without jargon, and default to async communication that others can follow.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Are eager to contribute to the engineering team's growth - code review, mentoring, and interviewing included.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Value transparency, ownership, and speed over perfection. You ship, learn, and improve rather than waiting for the perfect plan.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Nice to have:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Experience with TanStack is a bonus, and so is a real understanding of frontend caching and eventual consistency, we'd love to hire someone who's dealt with that tradeoff directly.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Experience with capacity planning, scheduling, reporting, or other complex B2B SaaS products.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Experience working with distributed or microservice systems, a basic understanding of infrastructure and infrastructure as code, and some experience creating, improving, or debugging CI/CD pipelines.</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>This Role Is NOT</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>A ticket-taker role. If you want fully specced work handed to you, this isn't the right fit.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>A pixel-pusher translating finished designs into code with no say in the problem or the solution.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>A role where you hand off at the API boundary. If "that's a backend ticket" is your instinct, this will frustrate you.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>A role where quality is someone else's job. Toggl doesn't have a dedicated QA<br>team or layer: there's no separate team that will catch your bugs, write your<br>tests, or own your performance regressions.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>A place to work in isolation from users. You'll be expected to know who you're building for and why.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>A role for people who need heavy process, frequent approvals, or top-down direction to do their best work.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>The Team</strong></p>
<p>We are a global team of ~80 awesome people working from over 40 countries around the globe. We hire globally, you work locally—in the heart of London, a beach outside of Río de Janeiro, or a quiet village near Florence, the choice is yours. Every few months we travel to meet up somewhere in the world and spend some quality time together. We place a huge amount of trust in our people, and we measure the outcomes rather than the work itself.&nbsp;<a href="https://toggl.com/culture/">Our values</a>&nbsp;fuel our results.<br><br><strong>What's Happening at Toggl</strong></p>
<p>Toggl is at an exciting turning point. We're taking our best-in-class time tracking - trusted and loved by millions of users worldwide - and expanding it into something bigger:&nbsp;<a href="https://toggl.com/focus/">Toggl 2.0</a>. One product that brings together time tracking, planning, capacity management, reporting, and insight. The idea is simple: better time tracking creates better data, which powers everything else. We call it time intelligence. We build with AI throughout, and we think it's a real multiplier for strong engineers rather than a substitute for them. The judgment, the tradeoffs, and the accountability for what ships stay with people.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Benefits</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Freedom to choose when and how much you work—we only measure results</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>24 days of paid time off a year, plus your local holidays</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Unlimited sick leave</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>In-person meetups for team-building (expenses covered)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>4-6 weeks paid sabbatical (depending on tenure)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Laptop budget up to 2,500€ and it renews every 3 years</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>€2,000 budget to set up your home office and an additional €300 every year after 3 years of tenure</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>€3,000 per year for co-working space membership and/or internet service at home</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>€4,000 per year contribution to use for training, workshops, and conferences</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>€2,400 per year contribution for any equipment or services to improve and/or maintain your physical and mental health</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Support for buying tools you need for doing your best work (even eyeglasses if you need a new pair)</p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/toggl-senior-full-stack">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/toggl-senior-full-stack</a></p>
</description>

      <title>Glean: Application Security Engineer</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> United States, Remote
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><div><span><strong>About Glean:</strong></span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles.</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level.</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality.</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more - deeply embedded where people get things done. You’ll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company.</span></div></div><p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span><strong>About the Role:</strong></span></p>
<p><span>Glean is looking for an experienced <strong>Application Security Engineer</strong> with a primary focus on ensuring that our entire technology stack is free of software vulnerabilities (CVEs). This role is responsible for securing our base OS images, ensuring all open-source software (OSS) dependencies are scanned and patched, and integrating cutting-edge security tools into our CI/CD pipeline. The ideal candidate will drive the adoption of solutions like Google’s Assured Open Source Software (OSS) and explore alternative approaches to enhance software security. This role will lead the vulnerability management charter at Glean, identifying, evaluating, and implementing new security technologies and processes to proactively protect our infrastructure.</span></p>
<h3><span><strong>You will:</strong></span></h3>
<ul>
<li class="wnfdnte _1ibi0s33w"><span>Own the vulnerability management lifecycle across Glean’s technology stack, from discovery and prioritization through remediation, reporting, and measurement.</span></li>
<li class="wnfdnte _1ibi0s33w">
<div class="wnfdntu _1ibi0s3f5 _1ibi0s3ce _1ibi0s3ea"><span>Harden base OS images and secure open-source dependencies, package managers, and the broader software supply chain.</span></div>
</li>
<li class="wnfdnte _1ibi0s33w">
<div class="wnfdntu _1ibi0s3f5 _1ibi0s3ce _1ibi0s3ea"><span>Integrate SAST, DAST, dependency scanning, and automated security validation into CI/CD pipelines.</span></div>
</li>
<li class="wnfdnte _1ibi0s33w">
<div class="wnfdntu _1ibi0s3f5 _1ibi0s3ce _1ibi0s3ea"><span>Evaluate, adopt, and develop security solutions and tooling, including Google’s Assured OSS and comparable approaches.</span></div>
</li>
<li class="wnfdnte _1ibi0s33w">
<div class="wnfdntu _1ibi0s3f5 _1ibi0s3ce _1ibi0s3ea"><span>Define secure-coding practices and drive engineering adoption through guidance, training, and mentorship.</span></div>
</li>
</ul>
<h3><span><strong>About you:</strong></span></h3>
<ul>
<li><span>BA/BS in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related field (or equivalent industry experience).</span></li>
<li><span>8+ years of experience in application security and vulnerability management.</span></li>
<li><span>Deep understanding of software security vulnerabilities, including CVEs, OWASP Top 10, and supply chain risks.</span></li>
<li><span>Experience with SAST, DAST, dependency scanning, and vulnerability management tools (e.g., Snyk, GitHub Dependabot, Trivy, Clair, Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP).</span>&nbsp;</li>
<li><span>Hands-on experience with cloud-native security across AWS, GCP, including containers, Kubernetes, and microservices.</span></li>
<li><span>Ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and drive security adoption across engineering teams.</span></li>
<li><span>Proactive, pragmatic, and collaborative, with strong problem-solving skills and the ability to balance security with performance and usability.</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span><strong>Location:&nbsp;</strong></span></p>
<ul>
<li><span>This role is remote</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span><strong>Compensation &amp; Benefits:</strong></span></p>
<p><span>The standard base salary range for this position is $185,000 - $260,000 annually. Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.</span></p>
<div><span>We offer a comprehensive benefits package including competitive compensation, Medical, Vision, and Dental coverage, generous time-off policy, and the opportunity to contribute to your 401k plan to support your long-term goals. When you join, you'll receive a home office improvement stipend, as well as an annual education and wellness stipends to support your growth and wellbeing. We foster a vibrant company culture through regular events, and provide healthy lunches daily to keep you fueled and focused.</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>We’re committed to building and sustaining a diverse, inclusive workplace. We strive to attract and retain people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we do not discriminate on the basis of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race.<span class="screenreader-hidden-offscreen">&nbsp;</span></span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>#LI-REMOTE</span></div><div class="content-conclusion"><div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span><strong>AI-First Mindset at Glean:</strong></span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. <strong>As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role. </strong>Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today — prior Glean experience isn't required.</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span><strong>Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants:</strong></span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), or other privacy laws may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. Our full notice outlining how data will be processed as part of the application procedure for applicable locations is available in our <a href="https://www.glean.com/privacy"><strong>Privacy Policy</strong></a>. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. US applicants and their applications are subject to arbitration of disputes as outlined in our <a href="https://www.glean.com/arbitrationagreement"><strong>Applicant Arbitration Agreement</strong></a>.</span></div>
<div><span><br>By clicking “Submit Application,” I confirm that I have read the Global Data Privacy Notice and the <a href="https://www.glean.com/arbitrationagreement"><strong>Applicant Arbitration Agreement</strong></a>, and I agree to the terms.&nbsp;&nbsp;</span></div></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/glean-application-security-engineer">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/glean-application-security-engineer</a></p>
</description>

      <title>Adventure Travel 365: Senior Full-Stack Developer - Marketplace Web & Mobile Platform</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0076/3373/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Phoenix, Arizona
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://adventuretravel365.com/">https://adventuretravel365.com/</a>
</p>

<h2>Senior Full-Stack Developer - Marketplace Web &amp; Mobile Platform</h2>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">We have a big idea, and we’re looking for a <strong>top-notch Senior Full-Stack Developer</strong> to help us bring it to life.</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">We’re building a new contractor referral and services marketplace, think <strong>Thumbtack or Angi</strong>, where clients can easily find and connect with contractors and service providers. The vision includes both an interactive web platform and mobile app, with everything from user accounts and referrals to job tracking, payments, advertising, and more.</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd"><strong>This is a fully remote, full-time, ongoing position, and we’re open to applicants worldwide.</strong></p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">There are a lot of moving pieces, which is exactly why we’re looking for someone who has built something like this before and gets excited about taking a platform from an idea to a working product, then continuing to grow it with us.</p>
<h2>What You’ll Help Us Build</h2>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">The platform will have two main sides: <strong>clients looking for services and contractors/vendors looking for business.</strong></p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">Some of the functionality we’re planning includes:</p>
<ul>
<li>Client and contractor/vendor accounts and profiles</li>
<li>Contractor listings, categories, search, and filtering</li>
<li>Service requests, inquiries, referrals, and lead management</li>
<li>Job and project tracking</li>
<li>Client and vendor dashboards</li>
<li>Online payments and transaction tracking</li>
<li>Reviews and ratings</li>
<li>Notifications and communications</li>
<li>Banner advertising and paid promotional opportunities</li>
<li>Admin tools for managing the platform</li>
<li>Reporting and analytics</li>
<li>Secure management of user, job, and transaction data</li>
</ul>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">And probably more! We have a strong vision for where we want this to go, but we also want the right developer to help us determine the smartest way to build it.</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">This will be an evolving platform, so we’re looking for someone who wants to <strong>grow with it, not simply complete a checklist of features.</strong></p>
<h2>Who We’re Looking For</h2>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">We’d love to find someone with strong experience in <strong>full-stack web and mobile development</strong>, especially someone who has worked on a marketplace, booking platform, service-provider network, or another multi-user platform.</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">You should be comfortable with:</p>
<ul>
<li>Full-stack web development</li>
<li>Mobile or cross-platform app development</li>
<li>Strong front-end <strong>and</strong> back-end development</li>
<li>Multi-user marketplace platforms</li>
<li>User authentication and account management</li>
<li>Payment gateway integrations</li>
<li>Databases and APIs</li>
<li>Third-party integrations</li>
<li>Dashboards and reporting</li>
<li>Secure, scalable application architecture</li>
<li>Cloud hosting and deployment</li>
<li>Testing, maintenance, and optimization</li>
<li>Using modern <strong>AI-powered development tools</strong> and integrating AI capabilities into web and mobile applications</li>
</ul>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">If you’ve worked on something similar to <strong>Thumbtack, Angi, TaskRabbit, Upwork, or another two-sided marketplace</strong>, we definitely want to hear about it.</p>
<h2>More Than Just Coding</h2>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">We’re not looking for someone who simply waits for a list of instructions and starts coding.</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">We want someone who can look at the big picture, ask the right questions, recommend the best technical approach, flag potential challenges, and help turn our ideas into a platform that’s intuitive, scalable, and built to grow.</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">You’ll also be expected to <strong>study established platforms like Thumbtack and Angi</strong>, understand how their user journeys and marketplace functionality work from both the client and service-provider sides, and use those learnings to help us determine the best approach for our own platform.</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">You should be able to take the project through <strong>planning, architecture, development, testing, launch, and beyond</strong>, while communicating clearly with a non-technical team along the way.</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd"><strong>Strong spoken and written English communication skills are important.</strong> You should be comfortable discussing ideas, explaining technical decisions clearly, and communicating regularly with a non-technical team.</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">This is <strong>not a short-term build-and-leave project.</strong> We’re looking for someone who can stay with the platform as it grows, helping us continually improve, expand, and maintain it over time.</p>
<h2>Interested? Tell Us About Yourself</h2>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">Please send us:</p>
<ul>
<li>A quick introduction</li>
<li>Your resume or LinkedIn profile</li>
<li>Your portfolio and links to websites/apps you’ve built</li>
<li>Examples of marketplaces, booking platforms, referral systems, or payment-enabled platforms you’ve worked on</li>
<li>What <strong>you personally worked on</strong> for those projects</li>
<li>Your experience using AI in development</li>
<li>What technologies/frameworks you’d recommend for a project like this and why</li>
<li>Your availability</li>
</ul>
<p class="isSelectedEnd"><strong>A short video introduction would be great, too!</strong> Nothing overly formal, just a quick introduction so we can get to know you, hear about your experience, and get a feel for how you communicate.</p>
<p>Most importantly, <strong>show us what you’ve built.</strong> If you’ve helped create a multi-sided marketplace similar to Thumbtack or Angi, tell us about it. We’d love to see it.</p>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/adventure-travel-365-senior-full-stack-developer-marketplace-web-mobile-platform">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/adventure-travel-365-senior-full-stack-developer-marketplace-web-mobile-platform</a></p>
</description>

      <title>Hex Technologies: Cloud Security Engineer</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> SF, NYC, or Remote (US)
</p>

<h3>About the role</h3>
<p>We are looking for an experienced Cloud Security Engineer to join Hex’s security team. You will be responsible for ensuring the security and resilience of our cloud infrastructure, providing leadership in cloud security practices, and collaborating closely with our infrastructure and engineering teams to secure our cloud-native applications.</p>
<hr>
<h3>About the role:</h3>
<ul>
<li>Design, implement, and manage security solutions and controls for AWS environments and Kubernetes clusters, including appropriate isolation/sandboxing methods for Hex’s RCE-as-a-Service platform</li>
<li>Build, deploy, and maintain infrastructure-as-code using Terraform, ensuring robust security standards are enforced.</li>
<li>Conduct security assessments, threat modeling, and audits on AWS cloud infrastructure and Kubernetes deployments.</li>
<li>Collaborate with development and operations teams to embed security best practices into CI/CD pipelines.</li>
<li>Monitor and respond to cloud security incidents, identifying root causes and recommending remediation actions.</li>
<li>Provide expertise in compliance requirements related to cloud security (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI DSS).</li>
<li>Mentor engineers and advocate for cloud security across the organization.</li>
</ul>
<h3>About you:&nbsp;</h3>
<ul>
<li>5+ years of experience in cloud security engineering, with extensive expertise in AWS.</li>
<li>Demonstrated proficiency with Kubernetes security including cluster hardening, role-based access control (RBAC), network policies, and container vulnerability management.</li>
<li>Expert-level knowledge and hands-on experience with Terraform.</li>
<li>Familiarity with AWS security services (e.g., IAM, GuardDuty, Security Hub, CloudTrail, WAF).</li>
<li>Familiarity with CNAPP solutions such as Wiz</li>
<li>Familiarity with SIEM solutions such as Panther</li>
<li>Solid understanding of secure software development lifecycle practices, CI/CD security, and DevSecOps methodologies.</li>
<li>Relevant certifications such as AWS Certified Security – Specialty, Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist (CKS), and Terraform Associate certification are highly desirable.</li>
<li>Bonus points for security certifications from SANS or OffSec.</li>
<li>Excellent problem-solving, communication, and leadership skills.</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h3>Our Engineering team</h3>
<p>We’re a group of engineers who are forging new ground together and love partnering with Security on our journey to pull ahead of our competition. You can read about how we think through problems as well as how we learn from mistakes on our blog here:</p>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://hex.tech/blog/we-took-down-production/">How we took down production…</a></li>
<li><a href="https://hex.tech/blog/beyond-linear-notebooks/">Beyond Linear Notebooks</a></li>
<li><a href="https://hex.tech/blog/a-pragmatic-approach-to-live-collaboration/">A pragmatic approach to live collaboration</a></li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h3 class="Heading__HeadingInternal-sc-sir940-0 Heading___StyledHeadingInternal-sc-sir940-1 eQrUa-d">Our stack</h3>
<p>Our product is a web-based notebook and app authoring platform. Our frontend is built with Typescript and React, using a combination of Apollo GraphQL and Redux for managing application state and data. On the backend, we also use Typescript to power an Express/Apollo GraphQL server that interacts with Postgres, Redis, and Kubernetes to manage our database and Python kernels. Our backend is tightly integrated with our infrastructure and CI/CD, where we use a combination of Terraform, Helm, and AWS to deploy and maintain our stack.</p>
<hr>
<p>In addition to our unique culture, Hex proudly offers a competitive total rewards package, including but not limited to, market-benched salary &amp; equity, comprehensive health benefits, and flexible paid time off.</p>
<p>The salary range for this role is: $198,750 - $295,000</p>
<p>The salary range shown may be a reflection of additional factors such as geographical location and skill ranges/levels we’re open to. Placement in the salary range will be decided upon completion of the interview process, taking into account factors like leaving room for growth, internal fairness &amp; parity, your demonstrated skills, and the depth of your experience. Our Recruiting team will be able to provide more details during the interview process.</p>
<p>By submitting an application the candidate consents to the use of their personal information in accordance with the Hex Privacy policy:&nbsp;<a class="notion-link-token notion-focusable-token notion-enable-hover" href="https://learn.hex.tech/docs/trust/privacy-policy"><span class="link-annotation-unknown-block-id-754370997">https://learn.hex.tech/docs/trust/privacy-policy</span></a>.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Hex Technologies uses AI-assisted tools as part of our application review process, including for resume screening and fraud detection. These tools help our <strong>team </strong>evaluate applications and verify applicant information. All AI-generated recommendations are reviewed by a member of our recruiting team before any hiring decision is made. No application is automatically rejected based solely on an AI tool's output.</p></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/hex-technologies-cloud-security-engineer">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/hex-technologies-cloud-security-engineer</a></p>
</description>

      <region>North America Only</region>
